calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_period

SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 2
  AND s.store_id < 900  -- Exclude web store (900) to focus on physical stores
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY net_sales DESC

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  store_id,
  SUM(net_sales) AS period_net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date >= '2025-05-26' 
  AND business_date <= '2025-06-22'
GROUP BY store_id
ORDER BY period_net_sales DESC

SELECT 
  r.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  SUM(r.net_sales) AS period_net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_id = s.store_id AND s.is_current = TRUE
WHERE r.business_date >= '2025-05-26' 
  AND r.business_date <= '2025-06-22'
GROUP BY r.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY period_net_sales DESC
